name: Haru PC
description: Asks your phone before Haru PC changes anything, keeps work inside allowed folders, adds Haru's default skills, and can hand coding jobs to opencode.

allowedFolders.description: Folders Haru PC may change. Defaults to Documents, Downloads, Desktop and the Haru PC workspace.

readOnly.description: Block every change (used with small local models).

opencodeModel.description: Model for coding jobs handed to opencode (provider/model). Defaults to opencode's own choice.
